$comment: Unit-test failures that are KNOWN, COMMITTED and tolerated by the CI gate.
Every entry is debt with an owner, not an excuse. The gate fails on any failure that is
not listed here, so this file can only ever hide a failure someone deliberately wrote
down. Shrink it; do not grow it. Removing the last entry should leave allowedFailures
empty rather than deleting the mechanism.
Only failures reproducible from a CLEAN CHECKOUT belong here. The two
emailTemplates.dev.test.ts failures seen in a dirty working tree are deliberately NOT
listed: that test file is untracked, so it does not exist in any commit and cannot fail
